question: Two separate work permits had been issued for the maintenance work on a pump. One was for repair of the pump and one was for removal and servicing of the pressure relief valve on the discharge side of the pump. The pump repair had been completed but the servicing of the pressure relief valve had not been completed by the end of the shift. In place of the pressure relief valve a 'blank' had been loosely installed. During shift handover, the maintenance work and return to service of the pump was discussed, but no mention was made of the servicing work being carried out on its pressure relief valve. The pump was then started, allowing flammable liquids to leak from the 'blank'. This vapour cloud ignited, causing a fire. Which of the following actions during shift handover would have been most effective in preventing this accident?
options: Verbal communication in a quiet place between incoming and outgoing workers
Confirmation of permits signed off as completed
Discussion of the recorded process checks undertaken by the outgoing workers
A physical demonstration of the plant state between incoming and outgoing workers
correctOptionText: A physical demonstration of the plant state between incoming and outgoing workers
source: NEBOSH PSM Mock Exam Book extraction workbook

question: An incident similar to Piper Alpha (UK, Offshore, 1987), where two (2) separate work permits were issued for the maintenance work on a pump. One was for the repair of the pump and the other was for the removal and servicing of the Pressure Relief Valve (PRV) on the discharge side of the pump. The pump repair had been completed but the servicing of the PRV had not been completed by the end of the shift. In place of the PSV, a blank end flange had been loosely installed. During shift handover, the maintenance work and return to service of the pump was discussed, but no mention was made of the servicing work being carried out on the PRV. The pump was started allowing flammable liquids to leak from the loosely fitted blank end flange. The vapor cloud ignited causing a large fire. Which of the following actions during shift handover would have been most effective in preventing this accident described above?
options: Verbal communication in a quiet place between incoming and outgoing shift workers.
Confirmation of the permits signed off as completed.
Discussion of the recorded process checks undertaken by the outgoing workers
A physical demonstration of the plant’s state between incoming and outgoing shift workers.
correctOptionText: A physical demonstration of the plant’s state between incoming and outgoing shift workers.
source: NEBOSH PSM Mock Exam Book extraction workbook
